author: Martin Hogsflesh
text:
I had one when I was using libre 2 plus , you just have to slide the strap to get the right fit, then cut off any excess. Be careful not to make it too tight though. 
I found them very useful.

author: Chelle Carter
text: Ive been is using them for over a year and they are the only thing that keeps my cgm on my arm. Adjustment can be tricky at first but once you have it its fine. It's saved my sensor from being knocked off my arm on multiple times as the strap moves rather than the sensor being pulled off. I would highly recommend them.

author: Wolfgang Sander
text:
Fixed clips are not recommended by Abbott. 
If you tighten them too much, this can lead to a "compression low" effect (tissue fluid is displaced and the readings are wrong/too low). 
If the tape is left too loose, the clip and thus the sensor can slip and the measuring filament can be pulled out of the tissue.
